info.event: Severe Cyclone / Extremely Heavy Rainfall Warning
info.headline: RED ALERT: Severe Heavy Rainfall and Catastrophic Inundation Warning for Chennai Metropolitan Area
info.description: Cyclone Michaung outer rainbands are producing intense continuous precipitation across Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kanchipuram, and Chengalpattu districts. Peak observed rain rates exceed 39.08 mm/h with 3-hourly accumulations exceeding 42.3 mm. Topographic drainage basins (Adyar, Cooum, Kosasthalaiyar, Pallikaranai marsh) are rapidly reaching maximum capacity with extensive street waterlogging.
info.instruction: Extremely heavy rainfall expected. Evacuate low-lying areas and follow disaster advisories. Move immediately to upper floors or relief centers if in low-lying zones (Velachery, Mudichur, Madipakkam, Perumbakkam). Do not drive through flooded streets or underpasses. Keep emergency contacts active.
info.contact: State Disaster Management Authority Control Room: 1070 / Greater Chennai Corporation: 1913
